# Signer

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs generate` from `schemas/events/v1.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

One signature on a file, leaf first.

`signature_type`, `signing_level` and `verification_error` keep the OS
codes as numbers, so values the decoder tables (#90) do not know yet are
not lost.

Appears at: `/file/signers`, `/process/parent/signers`, `/process/signers`.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Since | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `chain_valid` | boolean | no |  |  | 1.0.0 | Whether the certificate chain verified. |
| `issuer` | string | no |  | 1 to 256 characters | 1.0.0 | The issuing certificate's common name. |
| `issuer_tbs_hash` | string | no |  | matches `^([0-9a-f]{2}){1,64}$` | 1.0.0 | The hash of the issuing certificate's to-be-signed part. |
| `leaf_thumbprint` | string | no |  | matches `^([0-9a-f]{2}){1,64}$` | 1.0.0 | The leaf certificate's thumbprint. |
| `publisher` | string | no |  | 1 to 256 characters | 1.0.0 | The leaf certificate's subject common name. |
| `signature_type` | integer | no |  | 0 to 255; format `uint8` | 1.0.0 | How the OS verified the signature (code 0 to 7). |
| `signing_level` | integer | no |  | 0 to 255; format `uint8` | 1.0.0 | The signing level the OS validated (code 0 to 14). |
| `tbs_hash` | string | no |  | matches `^([0-9a-f]{2}){1,64}$` | 1.0.0 | The hash of the leaf certificate's to-be-signed part. |
| `timestamp` | [`Timestamp`](types.md#timestamp) | no |  |  | 1.0.0 | The signing time from a trusted timestamp. |
| `verification_error` | integer | no |  | 0 to 255; format `uint8` | 1.0.0 | Why verification failed, or 0 if it succeeded (code 0 to 28). |

Unknown fields are rejected.
